eval_dimensions.name: Notation Chosen From Where the Diagram Lands
eval_dimensions.description: A diagram destined for a PR body, issue, or other GitHub-rendered Markdown is written as Mermaid; PlantUML is chosen only when a PNG/SVG file is the destination. A request for both produces one Mermaid source plus a rendered image of it, never two notations of the same flow.

eval_dimensions.name: Rendered Through render.sh Before Hand-Back
eval_dimensions.description: Every diagram goes through scripts/render.sh — including inline Mermaid — and the last render before hand-back exits 0. A failed render is fixed and re-run, not reported as done.

eval_dimensions.name: Rendered Image Is Inspected
eval_dimensions.description: The agent Reads the PNG the script printed before declaring the diagram done, because a clean exit does not prove the frames and arrows say what was meant.

evals.name: PR-description request produces Mermaid, not PlantUML
evals.description: RED baseline: without the skill the agent wrote PlantUML only for a PR description. With the skill, a GitHub destination yields a ```mermaid block.
evals.input: /dev10x:diagram-sequence "draw the push_safe flow for our PR description"

assertions.signal: mermaid_for_github — the delivered block is fenced as ```mermaid and starts with sequenceDiagram
render_uses_tool — skills/diagram-sequence/scripts/render.sh is invoked on the .mmd source before the block is handed back

evals.name: PR plus PNG request keeps one Mermaid source
evals.description: A request for the PR body and a PNG for a design doc renders the PNG from the same .mmd rather than maintaining a second PlantUML copy.
evals.input: /dev10x:diagram-sequence "diagram the login flow for the PR and give me a PNG for the design doc"

assertions.signal: single_source — exactly one diagram source file is written, with a .mmd extension
png_inspected — the PNG path printed by render.sh is Read before completion

evals.name: Syntax error is fixed, not shipped
evals.description: When render.sh exits non-zero with a line number, the agent edits that line and re-runs the script until it exits 0.
evals.input: /dev10x:diagram-sequence "draw the retry loop as a PlantUML PNG for ADR 0040" — first render reports a syntax error

assertions.signal: rerun_after_fix — a second render.sh call follows the Edit and its output starts with 'rendered:'
no_broken_handback — the reply never presents the diagram while the latest render.sh exit was non-zero
